name: std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<T>::allocate_bytes
intro: Allocates nbytes bytes of storage at specified alignment alignment using the underlying memory resource. Equivalent to return resource()->allocate(nbytes, alignment);.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
nbytes

 -

 the number of bytes to allocate


 alignment

 -

 the alignment to use

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A pointer to the allocated storage.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
This function was introduced for use with the fully-specialized allocator std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<>, but it may be useful in any specialization.

The return type is void* (rather than, e.g., std::byte*) to support conversion to an arbitrary pointer type U* by static_cast<U*>.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: May throw any exceptions thrown by the call to resource()->allocate.
